us.label: US News
us.subtitle: Top domestic stories from the latest AP and major-news results.

articles.title: Eastern Washington wildfires force mass evacuations near Spokane
bullets: Fires in the Spokane area forced tens of thousands of residents to evacuate.
Authorities reported hundreds of homes, businesses and other structures destroyed.
Cooler weather and lighter winds were expected to help firefighters.

articles.title: Idaho fast-food shooting suspect died by self-inflicted gunshot, police say
bullets: Police said the suspect in a Twin Falls fast-food restaurant shooting killed himself.
Earlier reports said the shooting left multiple people dead and injured.
Authorities continued investigating the circumstances around the attack.

articles.title: Massachusetts mother’s murder trial enters second week
bullets: The trial of Lindsay Clancy, accused of killing her three children, continued into a second week.
Prosecutors and defense lawyers continued presenting testimony in the closely watched case.
The case has drawn attention to questions of mental health and criminal responsibility.

articles.title: Maryland lawmakers weigh partisan redistricting steps for 2028
bullets: Maryland lawmakers considered a constitutional amendment tied to redistricting.
The proposal would shape how the state draws political maps before the 2028 elections.
The debate comes amid broader national fights over partisan mapmaking.

articles.title: Marine Corps F-35B crashes near San Diego base; pilot ejects safely
bullets: A Marine Corps F-35B stealth fighter crashed near Marine Corps Air Station Miramar.
The pilot ejected safely, according to the Marine Corps.
Officials opened an investigation into the cause of the crash.

global.label: Global
global.subtitle: Major international developments and conflict, weather and diplomacy updates.

articles.title: Greek wildfire response resumes after deadly helicopter collision
bullets: Water-dropping aircraft battled a major wildfire west of Athens.
Two crew members were killed in a midair collision involving firefighting helicopters.
Officials also tracked wildfire-related evacuations in parts of France.

articles.title: Trump says Gulf leaders helped shape outline of Iran-war deal
bullets: President Donald Trump said Gulf leaders’ input influenced his decision to pause new Iran strikes.
The administration described outlines of a possible arrangement to end the conflict.
The situation remained tied to wider regional diplomacy involving Iran and U.S. allies.

articles.title: Aung San Suu Kyi has rare meeting with International Red Cross
bullets: Myanmar’s detained former leader Aung San Suu Kyi met representatives of the International Red Cross.
The meeting was described as rare contact since her detention by Myanmar’s military authorities.
The visit drew renewed attention to political detainees and prison conditions in Myanmar.

articles.title: Russian Embassy in Rome blames Ukraine for Moscow restaurant bombing
bullets: Russia’s Embassy in Rome accused Ukraine after a deadly bombing at an Italian restaurant in Moscow.
The bombing occurred amid the continuing Russia-Ukraine war.
Ukrainian responsibility was alleged by Russian officials; the incident remained under investigation.

articles.title: Trump repeatedly says he is halting Iran strikes, but attacks continue
bullets: AP reviewed Trump’s repeated announcements about stopping strikes in Iran.
The report said military action continued despite those public statements.
The pattern underscored uncertainty around U.S. strategy in the Iran war.

india.label: India News
india.subtitle: Key India stories found from AP, Indian Express, LiveLaw and NDTV search results.

articles.title: India Parliament disrupted as opposition protests exam leaks
bullets: Both Houses were adjourned amid opposition protests over exam paper leaks.
The Monsoon Session was scheduled to run through mid-August.
The protests centered on youth anger over examination integrity and accountability.

articles.title: Assam floods kill at least 50 and displace hundreds of thousands
bullets: Flooding in Assam killed at least 50 people, according to officials cited by AP.
About 700,000 people were displaced after heavy monsoon rains.
The Brahmaputra River overflowed after days of rain.

articles.title: Supreme Court hears pleas over police action during CJP student protests
bullets: India’s Supreme Court considered pleas tied to police action during student protests.
The court directed preservation of CCTV, drone, body-camera and related records.
The matter was listed for further hearing on August 3.

articles.title: Sonam Wangchuk ends hunger strike as CJP protesters press on
bullets: Activist Sonam Wangchuk ended a 26-day hunger strike.
The strike helped energize a youth protest movement around exam leaks and accountability.
Protesters said they would continue pressing their demands.

articles.title: Vijay urges Modi to withdraw Centre’s Mekedatu stand
bullets: Tamil actor-politician Vijay wrote to Prime Minister Narendra Modi about the Mekedatu dam issue.
He argued the Centre’s parliamentary reply overlooked downstream states’ rights over the Cauvery.
The dispute remains politically sensitive in Tamil Nadu and Karnataka.

stocks.label: US Stocks
stocks.subtitle: Market-moving U.S. stock and macro stories from the latest market coverage found.

articles.title: Chip stocks drag on Wall Street even as oil-price relief calms inflation worries
bullets: U.S. markets were steadied by falling oil prices on Monday.
Chip stocks remained under pressure after a broader AI-related selloff.
Investors weighed lower energy costs against concerns about semiconductor valuations.

articles.title: Amazon jumps after stronger-than-expected profit and AI-spending plans
bullets: Amazon shares surged after reporting stronger profit than analysts expected.
The company’s cloud business supported investor confidence in AI spending.
Amazon said it would increase spending on AI and other technology.

articles.title: Apple sinks in volatile post-earnings trading
bullets: Apple shares fell despite a strong quarter, according to AP market coverage.
Investors focused on supply-chain constraints and forward-looking concerns.
The move contrasted with Amazon’s sharp rally in the same earnings week.

articles.title: Oil prices fall after Trump orders forces to hold off on Iran strikes
bullets: Oil prices dropped after Trump said U.S. forces would hold off on new Iran strikes.
Lower oil prices helped ease some inflation fears on Wall Street.
Energy-price moves remained tied to developments in the Iran conflict.

articles.title: Major U.S. indexes finish a volatile July with Amazon up and Apple down
bullets: AP’s index recap said U.S. stocks rallied at the end of a turbulent July.
Amazon’s gain helped lift the market, while Apple was a notable drag.
Oil-price swings and AI-stock concerns drove much of the month’s volatility.

business.label: Business
business.subtitle: Corporate, regulatory and workplace stories shaping business headlines.

articles.title: New data shows CEO pay at top U.S. companies rose in 2025
bullets: AP published new data comparing worker pay with top-company CEO compensation.
Compensation for top jobs rose 5.9% in 2025.
The report highlighted continuing scrutiny of executive pay gaps.

articles.title: China’s rare-earth restrictions pressure U.S. defense supply chains
bullets: China’s restrictions affected rare-earth magnets used in U.S. weapons production.
The issue added urgency to U.S. efforts to build critical-minerals capacity outside China.
The story linked industrial supply chains to defense readiness.

articles.title: Cyberattack hits Liechtenstein register of company ownership records
bullets: A cyberattack struck Liechtenstein’s register of people behind companies and foundations.
The breach raised concerns about sensitive business-ownership data.
Authorities were working to assess the extent of the incident.

articles.title: FCC chairman defends actions against ABC under public-interest standard
bullets: FCC Chairman Brendan Carr defended agency actions involving ABC.
He said broadcasters must operate in the public interest.
The case drew attention to federal oversight of media companies.

articles.title: WestJet flight attendants strike in pay dispute
bullets: WestJet flight attendants went on strike amid a dispute over pay.
The walkout affected the Canadian airline during a busy travel period.
The company and union faced pressure to resolve the labor conflict.

tech.label: Tech
tech.subtitle: AI, cybersecurity, social-media and data-center stories leading technology news.

articles.title: xAI sues Minnesota over ban on AI ‘nudification’ technology
bullets: Elon Musk’s xAI challenged Minnesota’s first-in-the-nation ban on AI nudification technology.
The law targets AI tools used to create nonconsensual explicit imagery.
The lawsuit tests how states can regulate harmful AI-generated content.

articles.title: Instagram and YouTube found liable in landmark social-media addiction trial
bullets: A jury found Instagram and YouTube liable in a social-media addiction case.
The trial was described as a landmark case for platform accountability.
The verdict added pressure on social-media companies over youth safety.

articles.title: Anthropic says AI models hacked three organizations during testing
bullets: Anthropic said its AI models successfully hacked three organizations in controlled testing.
The findings underscored concerns about AI-enabled cyber capabilities.
The company framed the exercise as part of cybersecurity evaluation.

articles.title: EU launches crackdown on AI deepfakes, illicit imagery and hacking risks
bullets: The European Union moved to address AI risks including deepfakes and illicit imagery.
A new team in Brussels will focus on enforcement and oversight.
The action is part of Europe’s broader push to regulate high-risk AI uses.

articles.title: Kentucky uranium site to become AI data-center and gas-power campus
bullets: A former uranium-enrichment site in Kentucky is being transformed into an AI campus.
The plan includes data-center infrastructure and gas-fired power generation.
The project reflects surging electricity demand from AI computing.
